rows: Thanks to its slow crystallization and the compounded carbon fibers, it’s possible to print Nanovia PEKK-A CF using a heated enclosure of only 90 °C.
A reinforced nozzle, suitable for abrasive materials is recommended.
We recommend printing Nanovia PEKK-A CF in a room equipped with air extraction or by using appropriate breathing equipment.
